item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00377","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C05","C02","C06"],"selected_candidate_label":"C05","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C05 plausibly supplied the child’s two-part drafting structure: first, delegation of specifically cited presidential authority together with implementing regulatory power; second, a savings clause preserving existing actions while treating authority to amend or revoke them as included in the delegation. The child closely adapts C05’s distinctive formulation that the order “shall not operate to” disturb existing measures and that authority to alter them “shall be deemed to be included within the authority delegated by section 1.” C02 closely parallels the delegation to the Secretary of State of authority to prescribe regulations and fees, while C06 supplies related preservation machinery, but neither matches the child’s combined structure as closely as C05.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"There is hereby delegated to the Secretary of State the authority vested in the President by section 1745 ... to prescribe ... rates or tariffs of fees","parent_excerpt":"the authority vested in the President by subsection 305 (a), and by subsections 606 (a), (c), and (d) ... is delegated to the Director","explanation":"Both begin by delegating specifically cited presidential statutory authority to a named executive official."},{"child_excerpt":"This order shall not operate to amend, supersede, or terminate any rates or tariffs of fees, designations, or adaptations ... in force immediately prior to the issuance of this order","parent_excerpt":"This order shall not operate to terminate or modify the effect of any provision of any other Executive order, or of any rule, regulation, or other action, relating to any of the authority delegated by this order","explanation":"The child closely adapts C05’s distinctive savings-clause syntax to preserve existing measures within the newly delegated subject matter."},{"child_excerpt":"authority to amend, supersede, or terminate the same ... shall be deemed to be included within the authority delegated by section 1 of this order","parent_excerpt":"authority to amend or revoke any such provision shall be deemed to be included within the authority delegated by section 1 of this order","explanation":"This is a near-verbatim and structurally identical grant of implied authority over preserved prior measures."}]}
